summary_rule: The quoted symmetric 68 percent halfwidth is used as a Gaussian diagnostic denominator, not assumed to be an exact Gaussian posterior standard deviation. Means and halfwidths are separately given half-last-digit nearest-rounding envelopes. No pooling, tail probability, likelihood refit or NS-TILT status change.
